analyses.content: 录音明确提到打铃让大家回教室点名（take the register对应registration）的时间是8点55分。
你可能会听到8:45或8:50，但那是预计到校的时间，而不是正式打铃开始点名的时间。
Children are expected to arrive at school between eight forty-five and eight fifty, and the bell is rung for everybody to go to their classrooms at eight fifty-five so that we can take the register.
录音说明除了学生可以自带午餐，食堂也会提供热餐（hot meal）。
你可能会填入干扰信息packed lunch，但那是学生自己带的，并不是学校食堂提供的选项。
Lunch is served in the canteen, and children can bring their own packed lunch or a hot meal is available.
录音直接提到上午和下午各有一次15分钟的休息时间（breaks of fifteen minutes）。
你可能会在听到fifteen时出现拼写失误，或者只顾着听后面的go outside而漏掉表示时间的数字。
In the middle of the morning and the middle of the afternoon, there are two breaks of fifteen minutes when the children also generally go outside, unless it's wet.
录音提到在周四下午，学校期望全校学生（the whole school对应题目中的all children）都去做运动（do sports对应take part in sports）。
你可能会听到lessons这个词并填入，但录音说的是“而不是继续上课（rather than continuing with lessons）”，必须排除这个干扰。
For example, on Thursday afternoons, rather than continuing with lessons, we expect the whole school to do sports.
录音说明在三个学期中的每一个学期（each of the three terms对应every term），学生们都需要制作一张海报（produce a poster）。
你可能会把后面补充提到的environment当成答案，但那只是海报具体主题的一个例子，并不是学生们要完成的作品本身。
So for each of the three terms, they are expected to produce a poster. This will normally be on something particular that they have studied that term, such as the environment.
录音直接指出每个月（every month对应each month）学生们都必须要进行考试（do tests）。
你可能会因为听到句末的year而填错，但year是指记录表现的一整年周期，测试的频率其实是每个月。
And every month, rather than the teacher giving the children a report, as I know some schools do, they have to do tests, and we record their performance over the year.
录音提到在放学后（at the end of the school day对应after school），孩子们可以去俱乐部（clubs）学习像音乐这样的新技能。
你可能会因为听到最后的music就被带偏，但这道题根据介词to，需要填的是孩子们能“去”的具体组织。
Our teachers are all very committed to the school, and at the end of the school day, many of them have set up clubs that the children go to for an extra hour to learn a new skill, such as music.

analyses.content: 录音明确指出起点在正门（main entrance），然后在右侧（on the right）就能看到校长办公室（the head's office），对应地图上的位置E。
你可能会一听到接待处（reception）就去找相关选项，但录音强调的是“通常你以为是接待处的地方，其实是校长办公室”。
We're here at the main entrance and on the right, where you would normally expect to find reception, you'll see the head's office. He likes to see visitors personally, and his door is always open.
录音提到在教室的左侧（On the left of the classrooms），有一个由旧衣帽间改造而成的音乐室（music room），对应地图左侧的位置A。
你可能会因为听到了衣帽间（cloak rooms）就去看D选项，但录音说明原来的衣帽间已经被改造成了音乐室。
On the left of the classrooms, we have converted one of the old cloak rooms to create a music room, and children can go in there at lunchtime if they want to.
录音带领大家穿过主厅（through the main hall），并指出隔壁（next door）的旧礼堂现在已经被改造成了体育馆（gym），对应主厅旁边的位置F。
你可能会被旧名称assembly hall误导去选B，或者因为没有跟上“穿过主厅”的路线而丢失了参照物。

Now, if you come with me through the main hall here. Okay. Now, as you can probably see, this main hall is a new addition this year, and we are very pleased with it. We used to be squashed into the old assembly hall next door, which, as you can see, has now been turned into a gym for the children, and we have weekly lessons here.
